svg.title: One Harbour v2, layer 03: quay
svg.desc: World 4800 x 2400. Parallax fx 1, fy 1 (the reference plane). Breakwater, quay wall (apron top y 1340, waterline y 1420), container stacks, portal jib crane with a container on its spreader (quay-crane-load: translate y from -65, lifted, to 31, set down on the stack; its ropes overlap the fixed hoist ropes), mobile harbour crane, terminal tractor, the port agent's office (anchor-A2), the DMC house (anchor-A3), coach, rock shore, the Embark guide hut with kayak rack and jetty (anchor-A4). Signal colour appears only inside lights-A2, lights-A3 and lights-A4 and as the hairline sun rim of the two cranes. Anything below y 1420 is covered by the water layer.
